This is a Disambiguation page — a navigational aid which lists other pages that might otherwise share the same title. If an article link referred you here, you might want to go back and fix it to point directly to the intended page.

There are two separate Sewers systems under Rathleton:

  • The Rathleton Ancient Sewers, located on the western side of the city, under Lower Rathleton;
  • The Rathleton New Sewers, located un the eastern side of the city, under the Workshop Quarter.

Note that even though they are located just side by side, they are are not connected to each other.
